message: Ready to buy T75 with loader today, paying in full.

Thanks for the offer, and glad you're ready to buy today. The T75 Row-Crop with the quick-attach front loader lists at $74,500. Since you're paying in full today, I can do $71,500 for the package. That's a solid machine for haying, tillage, and heavy implements, and the loader with the 60-inch bucket makes it a real workhorse.
Heartland posts T75 at $65,950 and loader at $6,300. $68,000 and I check out now.

I appreciate you being ready to check out today. I can't verify Heartland's pricing, so I'll just speak to our package. The T75 Row-Crop comes with the enclosed cab with A/C and 4WD, and it's paired with our quick-attach loader. I'll come down further to $70,000 for the T75 with the front loader, paid in full at checkout.
Meet me at $69,000 and it's done.
Deal. $69,000 for the T75 Row-Crop with the quick-attach front loader, paid in full at checkout. Thanks for your business, and enjoy the machine.
